page.overview:
Who is Antonio Branca?

Antonio "Toni" Branca was a Swiss Formula 1 driver who competed in 1950 and 1951 as a privateer. He drove a Maserati 4CL in 1950, upgrading to the 4CLT/48 model for the following year. His best finish from his four entries was 10th at the 1950 Belgian Grand Prix.
